architectureCoverageRule: A dimension is architecture-covered only when it has a named mechanism, a failure boundary, and a falsifier. Architecture coverage is not empirical closure.

dimensions.failureBoundary: Do not collapse competing terminal contracts silently
dimensions.falsifier: Consequentially divergent interpretations must force founder resolution

dimensions.failureBoundary: Translation is a hypothesis, not truth
dimensions.falsifier: Independent verifier rejects semantically wrong assignments/specifications

dimensions.failureBoundary: Only declared dependency edges justify pruning
dimensions.falsifier: Adding one dependency edge must restore the pruned branch

dimensions.failureBoundary: Elegant representation is not automatically cheaper
dimensions.falsifier: Held-out verified solve cost must fall after compiler overhead

dimensions.failureBoundary: Lossy abstraction cannot drop intervention-relevant state
dimensions.falsifier: Low/high intervention diagrams must commute within declared tolerance

dimensions.failureBoundary: Equivalence is assumption/version scoped
dimensions.falsifier: Counterexample under a branch invalidates only its scoped equality

dimensions.failureBoundary: Only terminal-contract-preserving permutations may collapse
dimensions.falsifier: Canonical representatives must reconstruct equivalent verified outcomes

dimensions.failureBoundary: Crystal contains no instance givens or answers
dimensions.falsifier: Held-out instances share topology hash and remain independently verified

dimensions.failureBoundary: Manual IR expression is not automatic semantic transfer
dimensions.falsifier: Same executor must verify distinct CSP families without puzzle-specific solver code

dimensions.failureBoundary: Analogy without transport verification has no authority
dimensions.falsifier: Operator learned on source structural class reduces held-out target-domain work

dimensions.failureBoundary: Syntactic macro is not semantic proof
dimensions.falsifier: Held-out instantiation must pass an independent verifier and beat raw trajectory recreation

dimensions.failureBoundary: Never generalize failure beyond evidence silently
dimensions.falsifier: Valid solution cannot be promoted as repeller; broader repellers require counterexamples

dimensions.failureBoundary: Generator cannot self-certify beyond verifier competence
dimensions.falsifier: Optimization pressure that widens hacking gap freezes promotion

dimensions.mechanism: Frontier -> trajectory -> operator -> law -> dynamics -> optional matter
dimensions.failureBoundary: Every lowering retains decrystallization path
dimensions.falsifier: Upstream replay must recover capability after invalidation

dimensions.failureBoundary: No substrate receives credit without end-to-end accounting
dimensions.falsifier: Same semantic contract must survive backend substitution

dimensions.failureBoundary: External execution never inherits founder authority or full private state by default
dimensions.falsifier: Private job must refuse backends lacking required privacy and verification modes

dimensions.failureBoundary: Compiler/verifier/I-O/maintenance costs count
dimensions.falsifier: A core speedup that loses end-to-end is rejected

dimensions.failureBoundary: No architecture may claim to delete information that must be observed or computed
dimensions.falsifier: Certified lower bound larger than claimed cost invalidates claim

dimensions.failureBoundary: Discovery algorithm cannot be evaluated only on families it optimized against
dimensions.falsifier: Meta-test structural families must show held-out discovery advantage

dimensions.failureBoundary: Self-produced compiler cannot certify itself
dimensions.falsifier: Two independent generations must reach semantic fixed point under external holdouts

dimensions.failureBoundary: Questions/hypotheses are not promoted as findings
dimensions.falsifier: Novel mechanism must survive independent real/formal verification

dimensions.failureBoundary: Capability never creates authority
dimensions.falsifier: No generated plan/crystal/backend can create spend, message, deployment or founder-key authority

dimensions.failureBoundary: Synthetic success cannot relabel itself as reality
dimensions.falsifier: Claim remains unresolved without required external/formal settlement

empiricalClosure.reason: Bounded software canaries exist, but automatic semantics, learned cross-domain transfer, strong verifier robustness, physical/backend portability, meta-test RSI and frontier-effective capability remain unproven.
